summary: Verified the baseline-pricing-diff bug fix end-to-end. Backend regression suite (3/3 passing) confirms GET /api/admin/pricing/versions/{baseline_id} returns diff=null and compared_to=null for the is_baseline=true '2025-04-14' version, while the active '2026-06-15' version still diffs against the version it replaced (compared_to == '2025-04-14', 172 cells changed, Uniform +6.5%). Frontend Playwright run confirms the Admin Console → Board Pricing tab renders no Old/New/Δ% table or 'cells changed' summary on the baseline (shows the 'Baseline version — the in-code rates all quotes started on.' message), and the active version still renders the full diff table referencing 'vs 2025-04-14'.

issues: React hydration warning logged in console: whitespace text node inside <colgroup> at /pages/AdminPage.jsx:249 (CategoryPanel table). Pre-existing, unrelated to this fix, but worth tidying — replace whitespace between <col/> tags with no whitespace.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_pricing.py get_version() now correctly distinguishes draft (vs active), baseline (no comparison) and other versions (vs the version they replaced) — logic reads cleanly and matches the spec.
list_versions ordering assumption ('newest-first') is implicit; consider an explicit sort key inside the comparison-baseline picker for safety if future migrations reorder the collection.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_baseline_diff.py is the regression guard for the pricing-version comparison-baseline logic. If anyone changes admin_pricing.get_version() or the seeded versions, rerun this file. Versions are listed newest-first; baseline must always be the original 2025-04-14 version with is_baseline=true.
rca of the issue: Before the fix, get_version() always set the comparison baseline to the active version regardless of which version was being viewed. For the baseline (original) version this meant the system would compute Old = current active price, New = baseline price, producing a misleading negative Δ% on the original. Fix: branch on the version being inspected — draft → diff vs active; is_baseline=true → no diff at all (no prior version exists); any other → diff vs the next-older non-draft version (its own change history). UI then naturally falls into the existing 'Baseline version — the in-code rates...' branch for the baseline because diff is null.
